requirements.text: The user shall be able to select structures by structure ID, district, county, administrative area (geographic group), ownership, custodianship, functional class, NHS status, on/off system, inspector, bridge group, inspection due dates, and all or some environment and elements.

The user shall be able to find structures based on the structure ID, structure name, feature intersected, facility carried, route number, LRS Inventory Route, KM/mile posts, structure types, design types and materials, and by searching the notes fields.
The user shall be able to enter a WHERE clause of the SQL query in the Find and the Filter window and run a query against the bridges in the database.

The user shall be able to select bridges on a supported map display and generate a bridge list for use within Pontis, for example, to perform a simulation analysis or to generate an inspection roster.
The user shall be able to create a new structure with a user-defined bridge key.
The user shall be able to create a new structure by copying all data of an existing structure.
The user shall be able to create new structure(s) by importing from a supported file type.
The user shall be able to edit and remove existing structures.
The system shall be capable of calculating NBI condition ratings using the FHWA NBI Translator.
The system shall be capable of calculating and storing bridge Sufficiency Rating.
The system shall be capable of calculating appraisal ratings.
The system shall be capable of calculating Structurally Deficient/Functionally Obsolete (SD/FO) status.
The system shall be capable of running a program simulation for a selected set of structures and storing the simulation results in the Pontis database.
The user shall be able to create new programs by manually entering program information.
The user shall be able to create new projects by manually entering the project information.

The system shall sanitize all user-provided SQL inputs and utilize parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection, and the ability to execute custom SQL shall be restricted to authorized administrative roles only.
All imported XML data shall be validated against a strict schema and digitally signed or verified to ensure data integrity and authenticity before being committed to the database.
Define the specific hardware configuration (e.g., CPU, RAM, disk I/O) and concurrent user load (e.g., 25 simultaneous read-write users) under which the 90% threshold response times must be achieved.

Add a requirement: 'All third-party libraries must have a documented maintenance lifecycle, be compatible with the .NET framework version used, and have a license that permits redistribution within the AASHTO licensing model.'

Define the performance targets under specific, measurable conditions (e.g., 'The system shall render the bridge list view in under 5 seconds on a 100Mbps network with 50ms latency for a dataset of 50,000 records').
Define concurrency limits (e.g., 'The system shall support 25 concurrent read-write users without exceeding a 2-second transaction commit time').

OPEN: The PRD mentions that bridge-level security is applied but does not define the granularity or the enforcement mechanism for this access control. - The system shall implement Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) that enforces read/write permissions at the individual bridge or project level, and all access control decisions shall be logged for audit purposes.

OPEN: The PRD mentions 'atomic database transactions' and 'multi-user concurrency' but lacks specific requirements for data recovery, RPO (Recovery Point Objective), or RTO (Recovery Time Objective) in the event of a system failure. - Add a requirement: 'The system shall support a recovery point objective (RPO) of less than 15 minutes and a recovery time objective (RTO) of less than 4 hours for critical bridge inventory data.'

OPEN: The PRD defines a capacity for 50,000 bridges but does not specify the expected growth rate or the maximum concurrent data throughput required for batch imports/exports. - Specify the maximum expected data ingestion rate (e.g., 'The system shall support the import of 5,000 bridge records via XML in under 10 minutes').
